caption: The drawing consists of two detailed pencil illustrations of spoons set side by side horizontally, one above the other, on a light-colored, plain background. Both spoons feature a slightly pointed oval bowl and a handle that flares out into a flattened, rounded end. The top spoon’s handle is engraved with cursive initials "BP," while the bottom spoon's handle is stamped with the text "BALMORE." The bottom spoon’s bowl also has a decorative element at the handle joint, resembling a shell motif. In the lower left corner, there is a small inset diagram showing the spoon from above, annotated with measurements; the dimensions labeled are "3", "2 1/2", "9 3/8" and "1"." Below the inset, the text "SCALE: 1/2" = 1'" is written, and the drawing is signed "G. Winter" at the bottom right. The entire composition is rendered in shades of gray, typical of graphite pencil on paper.
title: Silver Spoon
